svg.text: Perfboard build, 2026-10-27. Same nets as hardware/prototype/netlist.md (C1, C2, C3, C6 removed).
header: LRC BCLK DIN GAIN SD GND Vin
Never connect either side to GND.
Labels with the same name are one net: BTN, LATCH_OFF, AMP_SD, 5V, 3V3.
Every ground symbol is the one GND net. Join both − rails on the board.
XIAO and latch are drawn from above (USB-C and MOSFETs at the top),
with pins in board order. Other modules are drawn by function;
their header order is printed inside the box.
Latch pin pairs (VIN, VOUT, GND) are joined on the module: wire either one.
* Pololu doesn't say which button pin is A: use the one that worked in Stage 1.
Leave open: latch ON, CTRL, B; regulator EN; XIAO D2/GPIO3 (a strapping
pin); amp GAIN (open = 9 dB); NeoPixel Out.
On leads, off the board: battery, speaker, S1, NeoPixel, mic.
